source_text: Following general procedure F using 4m (54.5 mg, 0.25 mmol), B2pin2 (95.2 mg, 0.375 mmol), [Ir(COD)OMe]2 (2.5 mg, 0.00375 mmol) and 1a (3.8 mg, 0.0075 mmol) in THF (1.25 mL). Stirred in vial at 35 °C for 6 hours. Analysis of crude 1 H NMR using internal standard 1,2‐dimethoxyethane showed 6.1:1:0.3 meta:para:di(3,5) borylation (overall meta:para borylation 4.7:1)  in 94% yield. Purification by silica gel chromatography proved not to be possible, leading to product decomposition. As such, the compounds were characterised from the crude, which contained pinacol borane impurity, and NMR yield was quoted in manuscript.
